thread:
Eli (Support): heads up — cust-9182 hit an ingestion failure right after we applied a pinned variant for them. They say embeddings used to be 768 and now are 384. Indexer rejects the payload. Logs: 
```
ERROR: embedding length mismatch: expected=768 got=384 at /ingest/batch line 214
request_id=rc_91a2b3 cust=cust-9182 model=text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1
```
They included a sample request/response: 
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1", "input": "hello" }
RESPONSE: { "data": [ { "embedding": [0.001, ...] /* length: 384 */ } ] }
```
Need quick triage, customer is blocking a deploy.

Maya (ML Eng): thanks Eli. can you confirm whether the pinned variant is pointing at an alias or an artifact hash? sometimes an alias swap can silently change dims. also, did they pin to a quantized/low-dim variant?

Eli (Support): customer said they pinned via console to "text-embed-Redwood:v2.3.1-lock". They copied the variant dropdown option. I asked for the exact model_id from their calls — waiting, but attached their raw response above.

Jonah (Runtime): quick checklist from runtime side: 
- check model metadata endpoint: GET /runtime/models/{model_id}/metadata -> should show "embedding_dim"
- check routing logs for fallback: when capacity constrained we can route to a smaller/quantized variant with "variant_fallback" enabled
- check cache/batch layer for serving artifact mismatch (some devs saw mixed artifacts on warm-up)

Carlos (Ops): I can query infra. Running: `curl -s http://internal-api/runtime/models/text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1/metadata` -> returns: 
```json
{ "model_id": "text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1", "artifact_hash": "sha256:abc123def", "embedding_dim": 384, "quantized": true }
```
So the model artifact currently pinned has embedding_dim=384. That explains the responses. Need to find what the customer expected (768) and why the console showed v2.3.1-lock.

Maya (ML Eng): aha — looks like upstream we shipped two variants under v2.3.1: a float32 768 baseline and a quantized 384 fallback for very small GPU shapes. The console variant dropdown probably showed the high-level alias `v2.3.1` and the locked option resolved to the quantized artifact for that tenant (we have a rare alias->artifact resolution bug).

Eli (Support): summarized back to cust-9182: "we see the variant you pinned currently points to a 384-dim quantized artifact; that will break your index which expects 768. We're investigating and can either revert the pin to the 768 artifact or re-run your index with a conversion step. Which do you prefer?" They asked for a rollback to 768.

Jonah (Runtime): immediate remediation steps (ops runbook): 
1) identify the 768 artifact hash: `/runtime/models/text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1/artifacts` -> find artifact with embedding_dim=768 (hash sha256:fff777).
2) update the pinned model reference for tenant: POST /tenants/cust-9182/pinned -> { "model_id": "text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1", "artifact_hash": "sha256:fff777" } 
3) flush KV cache on the serving nodes for that tenant: `POST /admin/flush-cache?tenant=cust-9182` (graceful, should not drop in-flight requests)
4) run a quick smoke: curl embeddings request and validate length 768.

Carlos (Ops): I'm ready to run step 2+3 with a maintenance window. ETA 10m. Note: double-check routing policy so we don't allow automatic variant_fallback for pinned tenants. I'll also grep for other tenants pinned to aliases with quantized artifacts.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy text-embed-Redwood:v2.3.1 -> finished on pool-us-east-1 (ok=42 fail=0)

Maya (ML Eng): after rollback we should add a metadata check in the console when a user pins: warn if embedding_dim doesn't match their historical usage. Filed GH issue: RED-ops#1289.

Eli (Support): thanks team — I'll post the rollback plan to the customer and hold window at T+10m. I'll update this thread after ops completes and include smoke responses. :thumbsup:

Carlos (Ops): rolled back pinned artifact for cust-9182 to sha256:fff777 and flushed cache. Quick smoke: 
```json
POST /v1/embeddings { "model":"text-embed-Redwood-locked-v2.3.1","input":"hello" }
RESPONSE -> embedding length: 768
```
Customer confirmed ingestion resumed.

Eli (Support): marking resolved for now. follow-ups: console pin UX warning (Maya), prevent alias->quantized auto-resolve for pinned tenants (Jonah/Carlos), and reach out to customer to apologize + RFC on pin semantics.
